info.title: Issue13 full two-cycle recruitment contract candidate4 — NOT implemented runtime
info.description: Policies L1 core/G1/A1 adopted in Flutter comment78. Full target recruitment surface and manual completion; review candidate, not native implementation handoff/test readiness. Runtime openapi/openapi.yaml unchanged.

get.description: C/N metadata. View/create/admit coarse permissions are not character eligibility. No Wednesday midnight gate.

T must be N. Source C actual participation required. Omit both character_id/selected_role to use source character; replacement requires both. Target slots may be empty when permission is false. No writes.

post.description: Immediate bundle admission; approval bypass derives ONLY from verified source C participant. Token action must be join. Same A/T complete existing bundle returns noop; different character requires explicit change command. No automatic B cancellation.
Token action must be decline. Record explicit decline only if no actual target assignment. Failed join/closing UI never calls this. Existing target assignment requires cancellation context.

get.description: Only N cancellation. Auto successor or last-one close_target is adopted by comment78. Last-one cancels N only; Room and C preserved. Successor changes require refreshed context. Persistent relationship is retained and is not automatic quota recovery.

post.description: Atomic N bundle cancellation with context-selected automatic successor or last-one target closure. Cancelled future target is not current-week incomplete result. No global membership/room deletion or automatic quota recovery.

Read-only RR batch, no Idempotency-Key. Unique 1..50 own verified characters, 1..2 actual C/N cycles. No bootstrap/Armory reload. Any unauthorized character rejects whole batch. entries bounded by characters*targets*catalog raids (draft catalog five =>500).

get.description: C leader only; T=N. intent=open permits missing/open N; cancelled N requires explicit intent=reopen. Server mints prospective IDs/revisions without DB writes; client copies them. Existing open N noop never replaces its leader. No automatic enrolment/confirmation of copied sessions.

post.description: Atomic explicit opening/reopening + source C leader actual participant. intent bound to token. Reopen preserves RoomCycle ID, increments generation and allocates new Round IDs. Never restores cancelled participants/reservations/consents. Existing open N is no-op; original ACK first.

get.description: Only T leader reads eligible actual T participants, at most8. No pending/legacy intent/review candidates. Token binds full list/revisions; POST specifies selected candidate. No slot changes.

post.description: Revalidate T leader and selected actual participant; atomically transfer target leadership only. Actor remains participant. No slot/reservation/other-cycle/global leader changes. Context120s and 06:00-bound; idempotent original ACK first.

get.description: Contract4 target adapter. Same actual T for path IDs/rounds/sessions/application and body/query. Target permissions/leadership and per-cycle settings/members/plan revisions; no cross-cycle writes.

post.description: SQL target/visibility + existing filters + experience_levels OR, then exact remaining-slot and member-count order, then pagination. Normalize validated experience values into cursor binding; no client page-local filtering.

get.description: Same SQL experience filter as POST search. Omitted list=[]; repeat experience_levels query key for OR. Empty query value, CSV, duplicate value, null string or unknown enum =>400. Repeated keys allowed only for declared array parameters.

post.description: Single atomic create. Checked C creation commits one room + C and N leader bundle assignments/weekly occupancies + immutable ACK in one transaction. Any N failure rolls back C too. T=N creates only N, never C+14. Same key/body replays original ACK, never creates a duplicate room; checkbox remains part of original form.

get.description: Own persistent membership required. leave: no unresolved leadership in any live T; other T effects explicitly confirmed. end: G1 plus safe global-last-member and no other actual T participants. edit_common_settings: G1. Exposes every required body CAS, no GET writes or fabricated target rows.

put.description: Global common-settings command; G1 authority is C leader, or N leader only if the C cycle row is absent (never closed/review C fallback). Uses room CAS and all-impact context token. 200 CommonSettingsAck has GlobalScope, post-command room_revision and actual affected_cycle_keys; no target scope or fabricated cycle. Changes only common settings, not cycle leadership/participation/reservations/completion. No-op keeps room_revision and affected_cycle_keys=[]. Same key and immutable body replay original 200 before context expiry/week/authority revalidation, including original scope and affected cycles.
T=C and now>=Wednesday10:00 only, including false/correction. Manual source only; party completion never erased. Read original ACK before new-cycle eligibility checks.

app_member_count.description: Distinct target cycle members holding active assignment leases, including review-held slots, not persistent global member count or legacy choices.

CycleKey.description: Canonical Wednesday date in KST; server validates target is C or N. No implicit rollover.

ExperienceFilterValues.description: OR values; []/omitted means no filter; unrestricted matches stored null. Null/duplicates/unknown enum rejected; sorting of valid values alone does not stale the cursor.

JoinedOrder.description: Canonical positive decimal; value <=9223372036854775807. Compare as integer/BigInt, not lexical string; no JS-number coercion. Server enforces bound.

Version.description: Strict integer at server; booleans/floats rejected.
